_comment: crAPI ground truth is a SCAFFOLD. crAPI needs an OTP signup (MailHog :8025) to obtain two customer tokens; until that auth is wired in suites/crapi.yaml and each row is reproduced by hand, every row is must_detect:false so it never inflates recall.
